1170-1770-2733-5954-8345.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Warp Speed.
Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

751-6006-7175.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

650-710-728.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

710-1258-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Abduction triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Abduction from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1870-4873-5087-5089.easyPrerequisites: Darksteel Reactor and Eternity Vessel have at least twenty charge counters combined.
1870-4873-5087-5089.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield.
1870-4873-5087-5089.description:
Use Karn, the Great Creator to make Eternity Vessel a creature.
Cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield.
The Ozolith triggers, putting a number of charge counters on itself equal to the charge counters that were on Eternity Vessel.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving all counters from it onto Darksteel Reactor.
Darksteel Reactor triggers, causing you to win the game.

277-3129-4772-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

907-5414-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Selesnya Sanctuary.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Selesnya Sanctuary from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability
Repeat.

5702-6441-7798.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
5702-6441-7798.description:
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the Forest that enters untapped.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Land that adds at least two mana

2348-3322-4019--85--172.description:
Play the land that taps for multiple mana.
That land enters as a creature due to Nature's Revolt, triggering Vigean Graftmage's Graft ability, allowing you to move a +1/+1 counter from Vigean Graftmage to that land.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding at least two mana.
Nikya of the Old Ways triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping the land creature.
Repeat.
2348-3322-4019--85--172.notes:
Note that either the land or the additional mana source must add blue mana.

If the land adds at least {2}{U}, the additional mana source is not necessary.

You may wait a turn after playing the land instead of using the haste enabler.

341-2781-6867-7056.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control
with at least one +1/+1 counter on it

3259-7296-7759.easyPrerequisites: Royal Talon Fighter Jet is a creature.
3259-7296-7759.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7296-7759.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Royal Talon Fighter Jet as attackers.
Royal Talon Fighter Jet triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3532-3536-5078-7750.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3536-5078-7750.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name "Sensei's Divining Top"
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Medusa triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

3532-3594-5078-7692.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Toothy triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2173-2469-4616-5220.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, Mortuary and Moldervine Reclamation trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card
Repeat.

223-3368-7411.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast an instant spell this turn.
223-3368-7411.description:
Cast Gravitic Punch by paying its mana cost, targeting Kalamax.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate by paying its mana cost, targeting Gravitic Punch.
Kalamax's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first ability, creating a copy of Reiterate targeting the original Reiterate.
Resolve the second ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kalamax.
Resolve the Reiterate copy, creating a copy of Reiterate, targeting the original Reiterate.
Kalamax's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 6 any number of times.
Once you have an arbitrarily large Kalamax, have the final Reiterate copy target Gravitic Punch. This'll create two copies of Gravitic Punch in addition to the original Gravitic Punch.
Resolve all Gravitic Punches, dealing infinite damage to each of up to three opponents.
223-3368-7411.notes: If you want more copies of Gravitic Punch, you can cast Reiterate with buyback and recast it after the original resolves if mana allows.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2056-2440-7375.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Saheeli, Sublime Artificer
1618-2056-2440-7375.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Arc Blade.
Arc Blade triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Saheeli, Sublime Artificer triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Arc Blade.
Repeat.
1618-2056-2440-7375.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Saheeli, Sublime Artificer. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

240-2511-4885-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements

3923-7117.description:
Cast Mystic Speculation with buyback by paying {0} due to Aang's cost reduction, causing you to scry 3 and return Mystic Speculation to your hand.
Repeat.

1545-2034-2919-3490.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1545-2034-2919-3490.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

1305-5900-7009.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{U} plus an additional {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
1305-5900-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk. Choose to have it enter with three lore counters due to its read-ahead ability given to it by Barbara Wright.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn

1462-2493-6801.easyPrerequisites:
You have seven or more cards in your graveyard.
Permanents you control that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {1}{W}{W}.
1462-2493-6801.description:
Activate any number of permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{W}{W}.
Cast Cleansing Meditation by paying {1}{W}{W}, destroying all permanents as they are all enchantments due to Enchanted Evening, and then returning all cards in your graveyard destroyed this way to the battlefield.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cleansing Meditation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1462-2493-6801.notes: You can repeat this combo as desired during your turns to continually wipe out opponents' permanents.

3240-4871-6560-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
When Nether Traitor dies, Anafenza and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Spirit.
When the Spirit dies, Nether Traitor and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Nether Traitor trigger, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

222-527-3967-5295.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3967-5295.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

325-5636-5796-6282.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have at least one card in hand.
325-5636-5796-6282.notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
325-5636-5796-6282.description:
Activate Psychic Frog by discarding a card.
Toluz's second ability triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Psychic Frog ability.
Repeat.

1987-3094-4002.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
1987-3094-4002.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting any two permanents.
Holding priority, activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding {3}.
Activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, copying Ghostly Flicker, with the copy targeting Sceptre of Eternal Glory and Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Sceptre of Eternal Glory and Lithoform Engine.
Repeat from step 2.

907-1479-6517.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
907-1479-6517.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it, Dragonback Assault, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Dragonback Assault trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

277-1479-2374-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
277-1479-2374-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Maja trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Maja and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Maja triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1922-2781-4605.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Blur.
1922-2781-4605.description:
Cast Blur by paying its mana cost, blinking Felidar Guardian.
Felidar Guardian and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking another permanent you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Felidar Guardian that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Felidar Guardian token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

618-3991-5256.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Faceless Butcher.
When the Faceless Butcher token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Faceless Butcher token.
When the Faceless Butcher token dies, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

643-1869-2792-3089.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{U}.
643-1869-2792-3089.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}.
Cast Great Whale by paying {5}{U}{U}.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it and Inalla trigger.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Great Whale.
When the Great Whale token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Barrin by paying {2} and sacrificing the Great Whale token, returning the nontoken Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

914-2136-3750.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2136-3750.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Dockside Extortionist with haste.
When the token Dockside Extortionists enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating at least fifteen Treasure tokens.
Activate fourteen Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {9}{R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

1594-5078-5243.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

1267-3632-3753-4600-5241.notablePrerequisites: Gudul Lurker does not have summoning sickness.
1267-3632-3753-4600-5241.description:
Declare Gudul Lurker as an attacker.
During the declare blockers phase, when you recieve priority, activate Sakashima's Student's Ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{U} and returning Gudul Lurker from the battlefield to your hand, putting Sakashima's Student from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking as a copy of Medomai.
Deal combat damage with Sakashima's Student, causing you to take an additional turn after this one.
Cast Gudul Lurker by paying {U}.
Activate Erratic Portal by paying {1} and tapping it, returning Sakashima's Student from the battlefield to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

950-3230-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Fatestitcher does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Fatestitcher.
950-3230-4222.description:
Activate Coral Atoll by tapping it, adding {C}{U}.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Coral Atoll.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Fatestitcher.
Repeat any number of times.
